reviewer: Independent semantic and engineering reviewer; separate from amendment drafter and browser-run executor.
browser_execution: Parent executed isolated headless Chrome using the reviewed QA fixture. This reviewer did not launch or drive that headless browser.
visual_inspection_method: Every v2 PNG was opened individually through view_image and inspected; no pass inferred solely from DOM assertions or image hashes.
observations: All 96 screenshots show the specified target paragraph start below the fixed navigation; recorded top positions are 79.5 to 80.46875 CSS pixels.

The changed clauses and new academic-sequence/Paper 0 prefix are legible at all three widths in all eight languages, with no missing glyphs, amendment-related overlap or horizontal prose clipping observed.
Traditional Chinese new nodes are visibly converted. Whole rendered bodies were compared after each language selection by the executor, and report integrity and assertions were independently audited.
Immediate neighboring paragraphs are readable where visible. On mobile, existing wide tables are contained horizontally; this focused amendment review does not certify all table scroll interactions.
scope_limits: This visual pass covers two articles in eight languages at three viewport widths, focused on four amended or corresponding units. It is not a full-series browser audit.

Screenshots capture the paragraph start, changed clauses and immediate context, not the entirety of every long paragraph. Ordinary continuation below the 900-pixel viewport is not treated as clipping.
The first run is not accepted visual evidence. Only its automated text assertions passed; the first eight reviewed images were incorrectly positioned and the other 88 were not visually reviewed.
No user Chrome profile or Safari was used for v2. The independent reviewer did not resume control of the user browser.

resolved_findings.finding: First-run screenshots captured before smooth scrolling reached the target.
resolved_findings.resolution: QA-only fix uses instant scrolling, checks actual scroll position, waits two animation frames for position stability and asserts paragraph start inside the viewport. New evidence was stored separately in browser-qa-v2 and all 96 images were independently viewed.
